column1: # Lane L5 ledger (docs/plans/2026-11-22-dm0b-scc-cut.md section 5 row L5 "component bodies",
# VERDICT: 11 of the 696 declarations in the 16 in-scope files leave the root in this lane, in
# two independent groups: the wake family (3 into runtime/wakectl plus 3 interface declarations
# of the same file) and skill discovery (3 into prompt/skills). The plan's premise that moving a
# component costs only "one mechanical step per port -- export the port's method names" is false
# for every other component: the root imports the component package, so a moved component may not
# reference ANY root declaration, and each blocked component names root declarations it uses
# (the blockers are anchors in the blocked rows, measured with go/types, not grep). Moved: the
# wakeScheduler type, its 3 fields and its Notify method, and the WakeScheduleController port
# interface with its 2 methods -> runtime/wakectl; discoverSkills, logTurnSkillUsage and
# logDiscoveryStats -> prompt/skills. The root keeps 2 one-line type aliases (replaced rows) and
# gains 2 accessors that exist only because the root adapter can no longer read the moved type's
# Columns: row_id source_file kind symbol source_line target_file target_symbol disposition hit line_end proof
#   moved     the declaration left the root and now lives at target_file/target_symbol; hit is its
#             baseline body hash and the destination body must match after the two documented
#             transformations (destination-package qualifier collapse; the renames in the proof).
#   replaced  the root keeps the NAME as a one-line alias of the moved declaration (type X = pkg.Y);
#             the body hash changed and the alias form named in the proof is checked.
#   adapter   the root declaration is a value/type alias or a single-return delegate of a declaration
#             that already lives outside the root; unchanged by this lane.
#   present   stays in the root for a named reason (method of *coordinator or *sessionAgent, root-side
#             adapter, constructor, root wiring API, root seam/tuning/error).
#   blocked   the plan's destination would take it, but a named blocker prevents the move in this lane;
#             the proof names the blocker and its anchors.
#   new       a declaration created in the destination package; the proof carries its caller.
# RequestedModelRole-style typos are not present in this lane. Verifier: .rush/tmp/sprint0/l5v/verify.py
